description.en:
One day, 10-year-old Yamato and his friend Miku discover a man in a back alley who's suffering from vicious stab wounds. The man recognizes Yamato, and uses his last breath to share a secret with the children: Yamato's father was the perpetrator of a bank robbery that is known throughout the country as the most puzzling unsolved crime of the 20th century. He warns them to "never trust anyone."  
Miku makes Yamato swear to keep the man's final words a secret. A few days later, Yamato's father is found dead, and the boy is taken in by Miku's family. The death is ruled as an accident, but Yamato has his doubts. Six years later, Yamato still can't stop wondering about the incidents, and resolves to take action.

description.en:
Yet another Edwardian manga from Kaoru Mori, "Shirley" is an evocative glimpse into the daily life of an endearing and diligent 13-year-old London girl 
after she finds a job as a live-in maid with a cafe owner.

The original five chapters of Shirley, as well as the oneshots about Nelly and Mary Banks, were first published as doujinshi around 2000-2001. 
In 2003, these seven chapters were collected in a single volume, published by Enterbrain.

Mori would later return to Shirley with chapters published irregularly in Harta: two chapters in 2006, two in 2010, two in 2013, and two in 2014. 
These eight chapters were subsequently collected in a second volume, published in 2014.

Additional singular chapters were published in Harta in 2018 and 2019, followed by chapters in Aokishi in 2021 and 2023.

Volume 1 also includes short stories about two other maids:
"An Afternoon with Nelly and Me", a story about a maid who becomes the playmate of the young son of the house where she serves.
"Mary Banks", the story of a maid working for an elderly master who loves playing pranks on his servants, yet she still cares for him.

Just "Shirley" or "Shirley Medison/Madison"?
When published as individual chapters in magazines, the title is "Shirley Medison", while the tankobon volumes are named simply "Shirley". 
When CMX published the series in English, they translated her name as "Shirley Madison", but the name of the volume remained "Shirley".

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 森薫

Mori Kaoru is a Japanese manga artist from Tokyo and the creator of the manga serieses *Shirley*, *Emma*, and *A Bride's Story*. Many of her works are centered on female characters in the 19th century, such as a maid in Victorian Britain and a bride in Turkic Central Asia. 

Mori's works are known for their high level of detail in terms of clothing design, historical nuances, and background work. Her manga series are often published outside Japan in larger, hardbound editions to complement the heavy detail seen on every page.

description.en: Modern Japan - One night when a meteor shower fell, dungeons infested with strange monsters appeared all over the world. People all over the world were now able to check their own "status". The days of peace have come to an end, and it has become people's duty to go into dungeons and hunt monsters. All humans are ranked according to their status, and the main character, Takashi Nakamura, who only has the lowest-ranked abilities, is ridiculed, but spends his hard days hiding in dungeons as a burden carrier for the strong. However, Takashi's fate begins to change when he encounters the B-rank monster Argos in the dungeon. Takashi can now freely teleport to a game-like fantasy [different world], and his experience points there can now be reflected in his current status.

description.en:
"Humanity is nothing but a nuisance to us demons."

A boy who was once bullied was reincarnated into another world as the Demon Lord Noct, aiming for world domination. However, just before reaching this goal, he and his army generals were sealed away through a cunning scheme. Then, 3000 years later, Noct finally succeeds in breaking the seal.

When had finally freed himself, he found a world in which monsters attack humans and where those same humans oppress the demons. Shocked by the current state of the world, Noct, along with his fellow Demon Lord Army comrades, once again begins to move to achieve world domination.

To this end, he first rescue demons who are about to be sacrificed and then they seek revenge against humanity.

"Kneel before me, world. My servants, march."

The world conquest of the strongest Demon Lord is about to begin!

biography.en:
**Alt names**:
鶴田謙二

---
During his formative years in university as a student of optical science, Tsuruta, who had initially wanted to be a photographer, had been inspired by the works of numerous science fiction authors, such as Robert A. Heinlein, and manga artists, such as [Hoshino Yukinobu](https://mangadex.org/author/706826f2-20a1-413f-a874-706f1b1f64f0) and his manga [Saber Tiger](https://mangadex.org/title/af8a97fb-3098-4833-90b3-7fceffe231d1), which had inspired him to create manga. He has also cited [Chiba Tetsuya](https://mangadex.org/author/bb386677-86cf-43ee-bc3d-28f3bb4bdf4e) and his manga among his inspirations.

Soon after graduating, he wrote numerous doujinshi and was an assistant to numerous manga artists, prior to making his debut as a professional manga artist. In 1986, Tsuruta made his professional debut, authoring his first manga series, the short work, *Hirokute Suteki na Uchuu janai ka?* (広くてすてきな宇宙じゃないか?, a.k.a. What a Big Wonderful Universe It Is), which was serialized in Kodansha's Weekly Morning seinen magazine, set in a world where the land was sinking into water. Tsuruta has cited that the inspiration to this debut work of his came during a train journey from Tokyo to the ocean at Odawara, during which he had seen numerous rice paddies and thought of the possibility of a train line passing through the ocean, after which he wanted to create a work where he could use this image.

Soon after, Tsuruta authored [Spirit of Wonder](https://mangadex.org/title/39187992-cd1f-4095-9f25-cc532b938393), among his most famous works, in which he applied many of his inspirations, which was serialized in Kodansha's seinen magazines Weekly Morning and Afternoon between 1987 and 1996, and was later adapted into an anime series.

After Spirit of Wonder, Tsuruta wrote short manga works, and also illustrated numerous art books, which were quite successful. In 2002, he provided the character designs for the anime series Abenobashi Mahō Shōtengai and also authored its manga adaptation.

In 2000, 2001 and 2013, Tsuruta received the 31st, 32nd and 44th Seiun Awards for outstanding artist of the year. He has also received the Hayakawa Award for best illustrator, in 2000.

Horror manga artist. Some of his most notable works include *Tomie*, a series chronicling an immortal girl who drives her stricken admirers to madness; Spiral Into Horror Uzumaki, a three-volume series about a town obsessed with spirals; and *Gyo*, a two-volume story where fish are controlled by a strain of sentient bacteria called "the death stench." His other works include *Itou Junji Kyoufu Manga Collection*, a collection of different short stories including a series of stories named *Souichi's Journal of Delights* and *Itou Junji's Cat Diary: Yon & Mu*, a self-parody about him and his wife living in a house with two cats. Itou's work has developed a substantial cult following, with some deeming him a significant figure in recent horror iconography.

In 2006, Junji married Ishiguro Ayako (石黒亜矢子), a picture book artist. As of 2013, they have two children.

altTitles.en: The Laid-Back Isekai Settlement Chronicles: An Ordinary Salaryman Begins a Carefree Slow Life Using His All-Purpose Build & Craft Skills!

description.en:
Motokita Tasuku, an ordinary office worker, was just about to log into Lab, his favorite open-world building game, like always. But then—suddenly, he loses consciousness. When he comes to, he's in a world covered in vast grasslands. "Is this... one of those isekai transfers?" he wonders, trying to open his status screen—only to find that he can't.

However, he quickly discovers that he can use an incredibly convenient "Skill" that lets him break down objects into materials and craft just about anything—just like in Lab. Realizing this, Tasuku starts by building a cabin, some furniture, a lush vegetable garden, even a stone bath... and thus begins his self-sufficient life in another world. Compared to his old life as an overworked, underpaid office drone, he finds real happiness in creating his very own territory in a world free of obligations. Before long, he's joined by a cast of colorful companions: Aira, the dependable catfolk; Belle, a gyaru-style dark elf; and Elise, a food-loving high elf.
description.ja:
平凡なサラリーマンの基紀多諏玖(もときたすく)は、今日もオープンワールド系ビルドゲームである＜ラボ＞にログインしようとする。……だが、唐突に意識を失ってしまう。
目覚めた先は一面に草原が広がる世界。「これは……いわゆる異世界転移？」と思いステータス画面を開こうとするが……開かない。だが＜ラボ＞と同じく物体を素材化し、なんでも手作りできてしまう超便利な「スキル」が使えることを発見する。それに気付いたタスクは、まずは小屋や家具、さらに緑豊かな畑や、石造りのお風呂……と次々に生活に必要なものを作り、自給自足の異世界生活をスタートするのだった。
多忙で安月給だった会社員時代と比べて、しがらみの一切ない異世界で「マイ領地」を作っていくことに幸せを感じるタスク。
そんな彼のもとに、頼れる猫人族のアイラ、ギャル系黒エルフのベル、食いしん坊ハイエルフのエリーゼら、個性的な仲間も集まってきて!?

description.en:
A vast, towering layered city, built by humanity after gaining access to advanced technology. As people gaze upon the city while its construction advances, or go about their lives as residents within it, humans and the things created by humans each continue to layer their own ways of living.

This is a record of "life", capturing various eras of a world moving toward its end.
description.ru: Огромный уходящий высоко в небо город, воздвигнутый человечеством, овладевшим передовыми технологиями... Обитатели города — люди и их творения — изо дня в день занимаются своими делами, наблюдая за продолжающимся строительством. Хроника «жизни» запечатлела самые разные эпохи этого мира, движущегося к своему концу.
description.pt-br:
Uma vasta e imponente cidade em camadas, construída pela humanidade após obter acesso à tecnologia avançada. Enquanto as pessoas contemplam a cidade durante sua construção, ou seguem suas vidas como residentes, os humanos e as coisas criadas por eles continuam a construir suas próprias formas de vida.

Este é um registro da "vida", capturando várias eras de um mundo caminhando para o seu fim.

description.en:
There's a red thread tied to my finger, and at the other end is... the yankee who sits next to me?

One day, straight-laced honor student Miyanari suddenly sees a red thread connecting him to his yankee classmate Hashiba. "There's no way this sort of person can be my destined partner!" is what Miyanari tells himself. However, perhaps through a trick of the red thread, Miyanari ends up in all kinds of situations with Hashiba, such as getting injured and being tended to, and getting trapped in an elevator together. As Miyanari continues to spend time with Hashiba, he realizes that Hashiba is nothing like his outwards appearance, and gradually comes to learn his kindness...
description.es:
Hay un hilo rojo atado a mi dedo, y en el otro extremo está... ¿el yankee que se sienta a mi lado?

Un día, el estudiante de honor Miyanari vio de repente un hilo rojo que lo conecta con su compañero yankee de clase, Hashiba. "¡No hay forma de que este tipo de persona pueda ser mi compañero destinado!" es lo que Miyanari se dijo a sí mismo. Sin embargo, tal vez a través de un truco del hilo rojo, Miyanari termina en todo tipo de situaciones con Hashiba, como lesionarse y ser atendido, o quedar atrapados juntos en un ascensor. A medida que Miyanari continúa pasando tiempo con Hashiba, se da cuenta de que Hashiba no se parece en nada a su apariencia exterior y gradualmente llega a conocer de su bondad...

description.en:
Ayaka, a fox spirit (kitsune), is not your typical divine being. Despite her supernatural origins, she is clumsy, overly eager, and struggles with her duties as a guardian spirit. Determined to help humans in her unique way, Ayaka’s well-intentioned but often misguided attempts lead to comedic and heartwarming situations.

Set against the backdrop of daily life and infused with mythological elements, the story follows Ayaka as she navigates her role in the human world, forming unexpected relationships and learning the true meaning of her responsibilities. With a mix of humor, romance, and supernatural charm, Ayaka-san wa Damegitsune delivers a lighthearted yet touching narrative.

However, for some reason, they always end up fighting. One day, Suku gathers the courage to confess to Ririka, but at that moment, he falls into a time loop. Every time he confesses, the loop resets! How can he ever date Ririka? A romantic comedy with a sci-fi twist, offering a heartwarming school story!

Namun entah kenapa, mereka selalu bertengkar. Suatu hari, Motohisa akhirnya memberanikan diri untuk menyatakan perasaannya kepada Ririka… tapi tepat di saat itu, dia malah terjebak dalam loop waktu! Setiap kali dia mencoba mengungkapkan cintanya, waktu selalu terulang kembali. Dengan begini, dia tidak akan pernah bisa berpacaran dengan Ririka! Apa sebenarnya yang terjadi?! Sebuah kisah romantis, komedi, dan sci-fi yang penuh kejutan dalam kehidupan sekolah!
description.es-la: En una escuela normal se encuentro nuestro protagonista quien esta enamorada de su amiga, pero que no puede encontrar la manera de llamar su atencion mas que molestandola de vez en cuando, pero con las motivaciones de sus amigas de poco a poco se acerca hasta que encuentra una oportunidad de confesarse, pero al momento de hacerlo todo se va al traste porque ahora esta dentro de un bucle y todo lo que hice un dia antes nunca ocurrio.
